chunks: "Patience is of two kinds: patience at the time of calamity is good and beautiful, and better than that is patience regarding what Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has forbidden to you, so that it becomes a barrier for you."

key_terms.الصَّبْرُ: patience; steadfast restraint in the face of difficulty or temptation
key_terms.الْمُصِيبَةِ: calamity; an affliction or misfortune that befalls a person
key_terms.جَمِيلٌ: beautiful; noble and graceful in character
key_terms.حَاجِزًا: a barrier; something that prevents and restrains from wrongdoing

ai.seo_question: What are the two types of patience according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that sabr has more than one form. Enduring affliction is praiseworthy, but greater than that is restraining oneself from haram, because such patience protects a person from falling into sin.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.565 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"Patience is of two types: patience during a calamity, which is good and beautiful, and greater than this is patience in refraining from what Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, has forbidden, as it acts as a barrier for you."
